title: Super Smash Bros.
shortDescription: Super Smash Bros. helps define a Nintendo 64 platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference platformer marker within the Nintendo 64 catalog.
Labels the source relationship without treating it as a popularity signal.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Classified for the Nintendo 64 platformer discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains source-aware discovery without copied review text.
